checks.evidence: web/recon.js:470-485 uses the last node id as after, requests another page only when the page has 5000 nodes, and finalizes on <5000; mergeNodes/mergeEdges dedupe by id (141-166) and buildDataset attaches each stored edge to its src key (188-197); lib/stream.js:80-95 pages id>after and selects edges whose src is in the same page, so no duplicate/lost ids or misattached edges in the normal page sequence.

web/recon.js:487-507 merges every delta node/edge into the local map before setData; buildDataset (174-209) covers all live ids, so every new node, every degree-changed node, and every edge src is present with its full local links map, and an edge inserted between two long-existing nodes is included on the next rebuild.

web/recon.js:174-215 builds and web/recon.js:501 calls R.setData with the entire live node set on every delta, never the §6.1 partial dataset (the comment at 168-173 admits the full-set choice); positions still survive because every live id is present, but the verbatim engine prunes ids absent from the incoming dataset (web/vendor/graph-view.js:633-647), so the literal partial call required by §6.1 cannot be used without an engine change.

web/recon.js:15-23 maps page "", endpoint attachment, artifact tag, unresolved unresolved, asset "", param attachment, focused focused; weights are taken from degree in buildDataset (199-209) and consumed by the engine at web/vendor/graph-view.js:690-694 and getSize (194), so node radius follows degree.

web/recon.js:289-324 sends close for the old scan, resets nodesById/edgesByPair and clears the renderer, then sends open for the new scan; onSnapshot (453-455) rejects replies whose scanId does not match both loading and currentScanId, and finalizeLoad (357-369) resolves only the matching pending generation; no location change or page reload exists.

web/recon.js:570-619 uses RECONNECT_DELAYS with a single guarded retryTimer; onHelloOk (390-414) sends exactly one scans/open pair per connection and restarts pagination, beforeunload (688-698) clears the timer and closes the socket, and onMessage (534-543) swallows malformed JSON.

tests/client.test.js:289-343 spawns real chromium and tests/client.test.js:510-543 connects over CDP and navigates the live server; the reload test preserves window.__marker (583-606) and the delta test compares real positions before/after and requires surviving ids (608-689); local run: node --test tests/client.test.js => 6/6 pass.

medium: Delta handling rebuilds the full live dataset instead of the §6.1 partial dataset (web/recon.js:174-215,501), making each delta O(nodes+edges); the engine prunes ids absent from the incoming set (web/vendor/graph-view.js:633-647), so the spec's literal partial set would drop unchanged nodes — behavior is position-safe only because all live ids are included.
low: A duplicate first-page snapshot for the same scan can early-finalize pagination: web/recon.js:457-480 treats the second first page as a page reply and finalizes when after <= lastAfter, so a >5000-node scan can lose later pages on a programmatic same-scan switch or duplicate open; the normal UI prevents same-scan selection.
The same-scan re-open fallback in tests/client.test.js:665-685 is unreachable because assert.ok(grew) at line 644 already fails, so that path is not exercised.
tests/client.test.js:691-725 only samples /admin and /api/ nodes for the type check; artifact, asset, and param mappings are verified by code inspection, not by the browser test.
